Class DnsDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.core.DnsDispatch
@Internal public final class DnsDispatch extends Object
Dispatch of DNS lookups: forward resolution, the answer returned, and reverse lookups.

One domain of the dispatch the instrumentation layer calls through the bootstrap bridge; the evaluation it shares with the other domains is DispatchEngine. Not part of the stable API (see ChaosDispatcher).

    • beforeDnsResolve

      public @Nullable String beforeDnsResolve(@Nullable String hostname) throws Throwable
      Called before InetAddress.getByName(String), InetAddress.getAllByName(String), or InetAddress.getLocalHost().

      An IP literal or the empty name is not evaluated: the JDK parses it, or returns the loopback address, without a lookup (isAddressLiteral(String)).

      Parameters:
      hostname - the hostname being resolved; null for getLocalHost()
      Returns:
      the name to resolve: hostname, or another under a DnsRewriteEffect
      Throws:
      Throwable - if an active scenario throws to simulate a DNS failure

    • afterDnsAnswer

      public InetAddress @Nullable [] afterDnsAnswer(String hostname, InetAddress @Nullable [] answer, @Nullable Throwable failure) throws Throwable
      Called when InetAddress.getAllByName returns or fails, to reshape the answer under a DnsAnswerEffect (override, family filter, shuffle, limit).
      Parameters:
      hostname - the name that was looked up
      answer - the resolver's answer, or null when the lookup failed
      failure - the lookup's UnknownHostException, or null
      Returns:
      the answer to return instead, or null to keep the original outcome; always null for an IP literal, which has no looked-up answer
      Throws:
      Throwable - if a scenario rejects the lookup or a filter leaves no address
